text_self_test_evidence: RecallForge text self-test completed in an independent Codex host session and returned the expected READY status.
multimodal_test_evidence: RecallForge multimodal self-test completed in the independent host and correctly processed the provided multimodal fixture.
functional_test_evidence: RecallForge performed material inspection, knowledge reconstruction, diagnostic recall, weakness diagnosis, corrective teaching, and follow-up practice.
material_e2e_evidence: Real organic chemistry course-material test: 16 lecture decks plus one 30-page scanned past-paper PDF. RecallForge catalogued 1047 lecture pages/slides plus 30 exam pages, identified recognition limitations, built a course structure, and entered an adaptive active-recall workflow.
recognition_warnings: Past-paper PDF contains scan-heavy chemistry structures and handwritten/small-text content; OCR alone was not treated as authoritative.
Several exam pages contain rotation, stitched-page, or handwriting issues requiring visual review.
Legacy PPT material could not be reliably rendered for full visual verification in the tested environment.
Chemical structures, mechanism arrows, and visually encoded formulas that were not visually verified were not promoted to certain conclusions.
One expected course chapter was absent from the supplied material and was not treated as covered.
